'''Annette Gabriele Beck-Sickinger<ref>{{cite web | title = Profile: Annette G. Beck-Sickinger, Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. | publisher = Sächsische Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Leipzig | url = http://www.saw-leipzig.de/de/mitglieder/becka}}</ref>''' (born 28 October 1960 in Aalen) is a German [[chemist]] and [[biologist]]. She has been a [[full professor]] of Biochemistry and Bioorganic Chemistry at the [[University of Leipzig]] since 1999.

==Career==
Annette G. Beck-Sickinger studied chemistry and biology at the [[University of Tübingen]] (Germany) and received her Ph.D. under the supervision of [[Günther Jung]] (Organic Chemistry, University of Tübingen) in 1989. After completing her doctorate, she undertook several research fellowships, including stays in the United States and Denmark. Following a postdoctoral fellowship in Zürich, she earned her habilitation in 1995, also in Tübingen. From 1996 to 1999, she served as an assistant professor of pharmaceutical biochemistry at ETH Zürich. 

In 1999, she accepted a position as a full professor of Biochemistry and Bioorganic Chemistry at the [[University of Leipzig]]. In 2009 and 2014, she was a visiting professor at [[Vanderbilt University]] (Nashville, TN).

Annette Beck-Sickinger was a member of the Board of the [[Society of German Chemists|German Chemical Society]] (Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker, 2004–2012; Vice-president 2006–2008) and of the DFG panel "Biochemistry" (2004–2012). She has been a full member of the Saxon Academy of Sciences since 2009, of the German Academy of Sciences Leopoldina (Chemistry Section) since 2012, and of the [[Saxon Academy of Sciences and Humanities|Lower Saxon Academy of Sciences in Göttingen]] since 2021. In 2010, she was elected to the University Council of the University of Leipzig; from 2014 to 2020, she served on the University Council of the University of Stuttgart-Hohenheim, which she chaired from 2018 to 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hohenheim |first=Universität |title=PM Detailansicht: Universität Hohenheim |url=https://www.uni-hohenheim.de/pressemitteilung?tx_ttnews%5Btt_news%5D=41648&cHash=e885da7808642e5ff0165d770d84de20 |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=www.uni-hohenheim.de |language=de}}</ref> From 2017 to 2023, she served as a member of the Board of the German Society for Biochemistry and Molecular Biology (gbm) and was vice-president from 2019 to 2021. She was a member of the German [[German Council of Science and Humanities|Council of Science and Humanities]] (Wissenschaftsrat) from 2012 to 2018.

Since 2021, Beck-Sickinger has been a member of the Senate of the [[German Research Foundation]] (DFG). In 2026, she was appointed a founding member of the FEBS Research Academy.

She has served and continues to serve on numerous boards, including the Board of the German "Verbandes der Chemischen Industrie",<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kuratorium {{!}} FCI |url=https://www.vci.de/fonds/der-fonds/kuratorium/seiten.jsp |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=Förderwerk Fonds |language=de}}</ref> the Leibniz Institute for Catalysis e. V.  (LIKAT) in Rostock,<ref>{{Cite web |title=LIKAT Rostock - Leibniz-Institut für Katalyse. Forschung über Katalysatoren: Committees |url=https://www.catalysis.de/en/institute/organization/committees |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=www.catalysis.de}}</ref> the Advisory Board of the [[Carl-Zeiss-Stiftung|Carl Zeiss Foundation]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Search {{!}} Carl-Zeiss-Stiftung |url=https://www.carl-zeiss-stiftung.de/en/search |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=Carl-Zeiss-Stiftung - https://www.carl-zeiss-stiftung.de |language=en-US}}</ref> and the International Scientific Advisory Board of the [[University of Basel]]’s Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Scientific Advisory Board {{!}} Departement Pharmazeutische Wissenschaften {{!}} Universität Basel |url=https://pharma.unibas.ch/de/research/scientific-advisory-board/ |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=pharma.unibas.ch |language=de-CH}}</ref> and chairs the International Advisory Board of [[Angewandte Chemie]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Scientific Advisory Committee and International Advisory Board |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/15213773/homepage/2002_edbd.html |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=Wiley Online Library |language=en}}</ref>

In addition, Beck-Sickinger serves on various award and selection committees, such as those of the [[German Chemical Society]] ([[German Chemical Society|GDCh]]), the Society for Biochemistry and Molecular Biology (GBM), the [[Federation of European Biochemical Societies]] (FEBS), as well as for various foundations, e.g., the [[Boehringer Ingelheim]] Prize<ref>{{Cite web |title=Boehringer-Ingelheim-Preis - Boehringer Ingelheim Stiftung |url=https://boehringer-ingelheim-stiftung.de/wissenschaftspreise/boehringer-ingelheim-preis.html |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=boehringer-ingelheim-stiftung.de}}</ref> and the Life Science Bridge Award.<ref>{{Cite web |title=In seinem siebten Jahr verzeichnet der Life Sciences Bridge Award wieder mehr als 100 Bewerbungen |url=https://nachrichten.idw-online.de/2025/05/27/in-seinem-siebten-jahr-verzeichnet-der-life-sciences-bridge-award-wieder-mehr-als-100-bewerbungen |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251210184238/https://nachrichten.idw-online.de/2025/05/27/in-seinem-siebten-jahr-verzeichnet-der-life-sciences-bridge-award-wieder-mehr-als-100-bewerbungen |archive-date=2025-12-10 |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=nachrichten.idw-online.de |language=de-DE}}</ref>

Beck-Sickinger supervised numerous early-career researchers from a wide variety of countries, including Italy, India, Spain, Denmark, and Pakistan; 93 doctoral dissertations were completed under her guidance by 2026. She also served as a mentor for 5 habilitation candidates and junior professors.

== Prizes ==
She has been awarded with many prizes including the [[Leonidas Zervas]] Award of the European Peptide Society,<ref>{{Cite web |last=ruczynski |date=2016-05-18 |title=Leonidas Zervas Award |url=https://www.eurpepsoc.com/leonidas-zervas-award/ |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=The European Peptide Society |language=en-US}}</ref> the gold medal of the [[Max Bergmann|Max-Bergmann]]-Kreis, the Leipzig Science Award (2016)<ref>{{Cite news |title=Leipziger Wissenschaftspreis 2016 zweifach vergeben |url=http://www.leipzig.de/newsarchiv/news/leipziger-wissenschaftspreis-2016-zweifach-vergeben |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260113234309/http://www.leipzig.de/newsarchiv/news/leipziger-wissenschaftspreis-2016-zweifach-vergeben |archive-date=2026-01-13 |access-date=2026-07-30 |language=de}}</ref> and the [[Albrecht Kossel]] Price of the German Chemical Society (2018). She was honoured with the membership of the [[Saxon Academy of Sciences|Saxonian Academy of Science]] in 2009 and in 2012 became an elected member of the [[Academy of Sciences Leopoldina|German National Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]]. In 2017, she was awarded with the Saxonian Order of Merit.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-05-24 |title=Sächsischer Verdienstorden für zwei Forscherinnen der Universität Leipzig |url=https://www.chemie.uni-leipzig.de/newsdetail/artikel/ehrung-fuer-annette-beck-sickinger-und-evamarie-hey-hawkins-2017-05-24 |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=www.chemie.uni-leipzig.de |language=de}}</ref> In 2019, Beck-Sickinger received the [[Vincent du Vigneaud]] Award from the American Peptide Society,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-02-27 |title=Akademie-Mitglied Annette G. Beck-Sickinger erhält Award der Amerikanischen Peptidgesellschaft |url=https://www.saw-leipzig.de/de/aktuelles/nachrichten/saw-mitglied-annette-beck-sickinger |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=www.saw-leipzig.de |language=de}}</ref> and for the 2018–2019 period, she was awarded the Chemistry Europe Fellow Award.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hickman |first=Daniel |date=2020-05-20 |title=Chemistry Europe Fellows 2018/2019 |url=https://www.chemistryviews.org/details/ezine/11222767/Chemistry_Europe_Fellows_20182019/ |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=ChemistryViews |language=en-US}}</ref> She received the [[Richard Willstätter]] Prize for Chemical Biology (Dechema, GDCh, GBM) in 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Richard-Willstätter-Preis für Annette Beck-Sickinger - Homepage der Gesellschaft für Biochemie und Molekularbiologie e.V. |url=https://gbm-online.de/de/news-details/richard-willstaetter-preis-fuer-annette-beck-sickinger.html |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=gbm-online.de}}</ref> In 2023, [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry|IUPAC]] recognized her as one of the world’s most prominent female scientists in the fields of chemistry and chemical engineering.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Meyers |first=Fabienne |date=2023-02-09 |title=Awardees of the IUPAC 2023 Distinguished Women in Chemistry or Chemical Engineering |url=https://iupac.org/iupac-2023-distinguished-women/ |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=IUPAC {{!}} International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry |language=en-US}}</ref> In 2025, Beck-Sickinger was honored by the [[Federation of European Biochemical Societies]] (FEBS) with the Sir [[Sir Hans Krebs Medal|Hans Krebs Medal]] & Lecture,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Sir Hans Krebs Medaille für Professorin Annette Beck-Sickinger - Homepage der Gesellschaft für Biochemie und Molekularbiologie e.V. |url=https://gbm-online.de/de/pressemitteilungen-details/sir-hans-krebs-medaille-fuer-professorin-annette-beck-sickinger.html |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=gbm-online.de}}</ref> and in 2026, she received the Viktor Mutt Award from the International Society of Neuropeptides.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Profil |first=Prof Dr Annette Beck-Sickinger Universitätsprofessorin Biochemie/Bioorganische Chemie workBrüderstraße 3404103 Leipzig Telefon: work +49 341 97- 36901 Telefax: fax +49 341 97- 36909 E.-Mail Schreiben Webseite Zum Profil Zum |date=2026-04-20 |title=Annette Beck-Sickinger erhält den renommierten Viktor-Mutt-Preis |url=https://www.uni-leipzig.de/newsdetail/artikel/annette-beck-sickinger-erhaelt-den-renommierten-viktor-mutt-preis-2026-04-20 |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=www.uni-leipzig.de |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-04-20 |title=Annette Beck-Sickinger erhält Viktor Mutt Preis 2026 |url=https://www.saw-leipzig.de/de/aktuelles/nachrichten/annette-beck-sickinger-erhaelt-viktor-mutt-preis-2026 |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=www.saw-leipzig.de |language=de}}</ref>

== Research ==
She is known for her work on [[peptide]] signaling, ligand-receptor interactions, especially of neuropeptides, their downstream signal transduction processes, and the chemical modification of peptides and proteins for diagnostic and therapeutic applications. She is the author of several biochemistry textbooks and has published numerous papers (>430 listed in PubMed; Google Scholar h-index 82, total citations >25,000). She has coauthored reference works on [[combinatorial chemistry]] as applied to peptides<ref>{{cite book|last1=Beck-Sickinger|first1=Annette|last2=Soderman|first2=Peter Weber|translator=Michael Weir Allan|title=Combinatorial strategies in biology and chemistry|date=2002|publisher=John Wiley|location=Chichester|isbn=0471497274}}</ref> and has participated in [[International Union of Pharmacology]] projects on standardization of nomenclature for [[G protein-coupled receptor]] peptide ligands.<ref>{{cite journal | last1= Michel | first1= MC |last2= Beck-Sickinger |first2= A |last3= Cox |first3= H |last4=Doods |first4= HN |last5= Herzog |first5=H |last6= Larhammar |first6= D |last7= Quirion |first7= R |last8=Schwartz | first8= T |last9= Westfall |first9= T | title= XVI. International Union of Pharmacology recommendations for the nomenclature of neuropeptide Y, peptide YY, and pancreatic polypeptide receptors. | journal= [[Pharmacological Reviews]] | date= March 1998 | volume= 50 | issue= 1 | pages= 143–50 | publisher = [[American Society for Pharmacology and Experimental Therapeutics]] | doi= 10.1016/S0031-6997(24)01352-8 | pmid = 9549761 }}</ref>

From 2002 to 2012, she served as spokesperson for [[Collaborative Research Centres|Collaborative Research Center]] 610 (“Protein States with Cell Biological and Medical Relevance”).<ref>{{Cite web |title=DFG - GEPRIS |url=https://gepris.dfg.de/project/5485142 |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=gepris.dfg.de}}</ref> She was involved in Transregio 67 (“Functional Biomaterials for Controlling Healing Processes in Bone and Skin Tissue—From Material to Clinical Application”)<ref>{{Cite web |title=DFG - GEPRIS |url=https://gepris.dfg.de/project/59307082 |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=gepris.dfg.de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Transregio 67: Funktionelle Biomaterialien zur Steuerung von Heilungsprozessen in Knochen- und Hautgewebe – vom Material zur Klinik – Der Transregio 67 erforscht die Entwicklung neuartiger funktioneller Biomaterialien zur Verbesserung der Knochen- und Hautregeneration in einer alternden, mehrfacherkrankten Bevölkerung. |url=https://research.uni-leipzig.de/trr67/en/home/ |access-date=2026-07-30 |language=en-US}}</ref> from 2009 to 2021 and headed the integrated graduate school “Matrix engineering".<ref>{{Cite web |title=Graduate School – Transregio 67: Funktionelle Biomaterialien zur Steuerung von Heilungsprozessen in Knochen- und Hautgewebe – vom Material zur Klinik |url=https://research.uni-leipzig.de/trr67/en/graduate-school/ |access-date=2026-07-30 |language=en-US}}</ref> From 2013 to 2024, she served as project leader and a member of the executive board of [[Collaborative Research Centres|Collaborative Research Center]] 1052 (“Obesity Mechanisms”).<ref>{{Cite web |title=DFG - GEPRIS |url=https://gepris.dfg.de/project/209933838 |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=gepris.dfg.de}}</ref> Since early 2020, Annette Beck-Sickinger has been the spokesperson for [[Collaborative Research Centres|Collaborative Research Center]] 1423 (“Structural Dynamics of GPCR Activation and Signal Transduction”), where her work focuses on the interaction of [[G protein-coupled receptor|G-protein-coupled receptors]] (GPCRs) with arrestin, as well as the molecular mechanisms underlying the allosteric modulation of GPCRs by [[small molecule]]s. The [[Leipzig]] Center of Metabolism (LeiCeM) Cluster of Excellence, which has been in operation since 2026, conducts research on and treats common metabolic diseases such as [[obesity]], [[type 2 diabetes]], fatty liver disease, and their complications; Beck-Sickinger contributes  with her research in the fields of peptide biochemistry and GPCR signal transduction.

==Controversy==

{{Main|Leipzig University internship controversy}}

In March 2015, Beck-Sickinger was at the center of a [[Leipzig University internship controversy|controversy]] related to comments made during correspondence with an internship applicant in which she stated she would not accept any male students from India.<ref>{{cite news | last = Mascherin | first = Von Claudia | title = Keine Inder - das sind Vergewaltiger! | work = [[Blick]] | publisher = [[Ringier]] | language = de | date = 9 March 2015 | access-date = 22 March 2015 | url = http://www.blick.ch/news/ausland/deutsche-professorin-lehnt-student-ab-keine-inder-das-sind-vergewaltiger-id3551341.html }}</ref><ref>{{cite news | last = Varghese | first = Johnlee | title = German professor apologises for denying internship to Indian student, citing 'rape problem' | work = [[International Business Times]] | date = 9 March 2015 | access-date = 22 March 2015 | url = http://www.ibtimes.co.in/german-professor-apologises-denying-internship-indian-student-citing-rape-problem-625708 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news | last = Phillip | first = Abby | title = German professor cites India's 'rape problem' in rejection of Indian applicant | url = https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2015/03/09/german-professor-triggers-controversy-by-citing-indias-rape-problem-in-e-mail-to-rejected-indian-applicant/ | newspaper = The Washington Post | date = 9 March 2015 | access-date = 22 March 2015 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news | last = Wendling | first = Mike | title = Second student allegedly rejected because of India's 'rape problem' | url = https://www.bbc.com/news/blogs-trending-31834228 | publisher = BBC Trending | date = 11 March 2015 | access-date = 22 March 2015 }}</ref>

The university declined to publish e-mails between Prof. Dr. Annette Beck-Sickinger and the student from India. However, the rector of the university, Prof. Dr. Beate Schücking as well as the students council of the university had the opportunity to review all relevant e-mails. Two independent statements have been published claiming that the mail published by the Indian student was faked as it only contained parts of the email conversation and that the student was declined for formal reasons.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.zv.uni-leipzig.de/service/presse/nachrichten.html?ifab_modus=detail&ifab_uid=665d5cbb8220150611074755&ifab_id=5961|title=Universität Leipzig: Nachrichten|author=Universität Leipzig|accessdate=July 21, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150612124206/http://www.zv.uni-leipzig.de/service/presse/nachrichten.html?ifab_modus=detail&ifab_uid=665d5cbb8220150611074755&ifab_id=5961|archive-date=June 12, 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://stura.uni-leipzig.de/news/statement-der-causa-beck-sickinger|title=Statement in der Causa Beck-Sickinger|work=StuRa Leipzig|accessdate=July 21, 2015|archive-date=June 12, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150612124416/http://stura.uni-leipzig.de/news/statement-der-causa-beck-sickinger|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Germany's ambassador to India wrote a letter condemning Beck-Sickinger and, stating: "Your oversimplifying and discriminating generalisation is an offence to women and men ardently committed to furthering women's empowerment in India; and is an offence to millions of law-abiding, tolerant, open-minded and hard-working Indians. Let's be clear: India is not a country of rapists," he wrote.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/blogs-trending-31834228|title=Second student allegedly rejected because of India's 'rape problem'|work=BBC News|date=11 March 2015}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://edition.cnn.com/2015/03/10/asia/india-rape-german-professor/|title = Professor apologizes for India rape comments| date=10 March 2015 }}</ref> "I would encourage you to learn more about the diverse, dynamic and fascinating country and the many welcoming and open-minded people of India so that you could correct a simplistic image, which – in my opinion – is particularly unsuitable for a professor and teacher."<ref>[https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/india-is-not-a-country-of-rapists-german-envoy-to-discriminating-german-professor/article6975221.ece India is not a country of rapists: German envoy to discriminating German professor (The Hindu)]</ref><ref>[http://www.thelocal.de/20150309/professor-causes-india-spat-over-rape-problem Prof rejects Indian intern over 'rape problem']</ref><ref>[http://www.ibtimes.co.in/german-professor-apologises-denying-internship-indian-student-citing-rape-problem-625708 German Professor Apologises for Denying Internship to Indian Student, Citing 'Rape Problem' (India Business Times)]</ref><ref>[https://www.deccanchronicle.com/150309/world-europe/article/german-professor-denies-internship-indian-student-citing-india%E2%80%99s-%E2%80%98rape German professor denies internship to Indian student citing India's 'rape problem' (Deccan Chronicle)]</ref><ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20150309230923/http://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/german-professor-apologizes-for-rape-problem-email-to-indian-student/article1-1324468.aspx German professor apologises for rejecting internship to student citing 'India's rape problem' (Hindustan Times)]</ref>
